author: WMediaLiteracy
quote: This game is 100 dollars if you want the full content available for the game. For that price tag, you would expect the game to be the most polished and bug free game you can get. That would be a fair expectation considering this game has been in development for around 12 years and is more expensive than a large majority of other games on the market. GTA 6 proves this expectation wrong by being littered in bugs, having an uninteresting cast as well as not giving you freedoms past games have. One of the main protagonists, Jason has one of the most uninteresting personalities out of any game I’ve ever played and on top of that, his voice acting is incredibly lacking in emotion or personality and instead sounds like an e-boy in 2020 trying to force his voice which just ends up sounding like grunts and mumbles. The game also punishes you for behaving like a criminal, which has been since the very first title in the series, a large portion of the activity in the game. GTA 6 punishes you for behaving like a criminal or doing traditional activities that basically everyone who has played a GTA has done like getting max stars. They do this by locking you into a “bad” ending if you do too much crime. I will say that the only two endings that seemed interesting to me in any way were the worst ending, in which both Jason and Lucia are killed, and the good ending where they both make it out. This good ending is only available through not pursuing crime in a game where crime is literally in the name. The other two endings, where either Lucia or Jason get captured with the other going free is very unfulfilling and does not satisfy the incredible wait for this game. Another large issue with the game is the lack of freedom. One example of this is the inability to use weapons in clubs or one certain side mission characters. In a way this feels too hand holdy, stopping you from doing things that could lock you out of quests, while also feeling restrictive. Rockstar would honestly have no reason to stop you from consequences like this because they allow you to lose out on doing certain quests by behaving like a criminal already, so this feels very forced and out of place. One last complaint for the game is the 30 fps cap. In 2026 I never thought I would see a new AAA game release with a 30 fps cap, especially from a company as large as rockstar with a 2 billion dollar budget. This leads me to believe that the game has been poorly optimized because even the strongest consoles such as the ps5 pro are unable to go beyond this 30 fps threshold. In conclusion, GTA 6 is a very mediocre game which is overpriced, overhyped and lacking in personality which made past rockstar games such as the older GTA games as well as the RDR series so great.
